_help: Track research: what each partner actually gets (rights), the Parade tier that follows from it, and the end year, each with its source. One record per partnership, keyed by 'deal' exactly as written in deals.json. tools/track.py reads this file. tier: T1 naming rights / principal / front of jersey; T2 major or premier partner, sleeve, back of jersey, shorts, neckline, upper back; T3 official partner with a named category; T4 supplier, community, licensee. ends: last season of the agreement, only when a source states it (endsBasis 'stated') or states a term from a known signing year ('term'). status: verified = the club, league or brand's own release; reported = reputable press. Never use Scout as a source. collected = date the source was read.
